_note: Normative guidance distilled from INTERACTION.md and the docs pages. Guidelines are citable artifacts; where enforcement exists it is named in `enforced_by`.

guidelines.title: Armed two-step delete
guidelines.summary: Deleting an entity listed in the UI is a two-step, in-place action with auto-disarm; no confirm() dialogs for these.
do: carry .arm-del with data-arm-label and a matching aria-label
arm on first activation (label becomes 'Confirm delete'), delete on second
auto-disarm after 4s, on Escape, outside click, or menu close
announce the result afterwards (banner or toast)
dont: no arming as a substitute for feedback

guidelines.title: High-stakes confirmations
guidelines.summary: Irreversible, security-relevant, or multi-item actions keep a native confirm() whose sentence names the object and consequence.
do: name the object and the consequence in the sentence
keep strings apostrophe-safe
dont: do not route entity deletes through confirm() (use arming)
guidelines.quote: Representative set: remove account · reset tokens · rebuild the index · clear a chat · enable auto-apply · approve a risky plugin.

guidelines.title: Reversible mutations show the reverse
guidelines.summary: Edits undoable in place need no confirmation and no danger styling; put the reverse control next to the action.
do: pair remove ⇄ re-include, snooze ⇄ wake, tag ⇄ untag
dont: no confirms or danger styling for reversible edits
guidelines.quote: Put the reverse control next to the action.

guidelines.title: Feedback routing: banner vs toast
guidelines.summary: Server/redirect results render an .msg banner; in-place JS results call toast(); kinds are exactly ok/warn/err.
do: announce every mutation unless the new state is self-evident in the same viewport
wording is past tense and names the object
dont: no page-local toast markup or query-param toasts
guidelines.quote: There is no `info` kind — use `ok` for a benign outcome and `warn` when only part of it worked.

guidelines.title: Row actions
guidelines.summary: Clicking a row opens the record; secondary actions live in .rowacts, revealed on hover/focus (always visible on touch).
do: inline the relevant few with .ra-inline; rest in details.menu with .ra-menu
sentence case menu items; destructive item is 'menu-item danger arm-del'
dont: no grey tags/categories styling here — that's product convention
guidelines.quote: Touch (≤767px): `.ra-inline` hides and the `⋯` menu shows.

guidelines.title: Editors end in a save bar
guidelines.summary: Editors end in .savebar: primary Save <thing> plus Cancel. Cancel is the way out; Back is only for a navigation backlink.
do: render server-side validation at the top of the form and focus it
settings cards keep scoped partial saves
dont: a card never submits fields it does not own
guidelines.quote: Settings cards keep scoped partial saves.

guidelines.title: Empty state anatomy
guidelines.summary: .empty = optional icon, h4 title, one line of reason, at most one CTA (.btn primary).
do: use for any list or card with nothing to show
micro-empties inside a feed may be a single .sub line
dont: never a bare blank area or a bare 'failed'
guidelines.quote: Give a specific reason and one recovery action.

guidelines.title: Copy helper owns the clipboard
guidelines.summary: Use the shared cp() helper / .copy element; the helper owns fallback and confirmation labelling.
do: .copy marks the copy affordance
dont: never call navigator.clipboard from page code
guidelines.quote: The helper owns the fallback and the confirmation labelling.

guidelines.title: Labels & accessibility baseline
guidelines.summary: Sentence case for buttons/links/menu items; name the object; keep the global focus ring; 44px touch targets; colour never the only signal; every interactive element has an accessible name.
do: name the object in destructive labels and aria-labels
keep :focus-visible intact

guidelines.title: Colour is never the only signal
guidelines.summary: Status and meaning are carried by text or icon as well as colour; charts must survive greyscale and colour-blindness.
do: label status lines directly
vary dash patterns or annotate in charts
dont: no colour-only dots or fills for meaning
guidelines.quote: Do not rely on colour alone: label lines directly, vary dash patterns, or annotate.

guidelines.title: Page hierarchy
guidelines.summary: One element, one token and one job per level: page title → section heading → card heading → body → meta. Don't skip levels.
do: let a long page title wrap at --fs-page-title
dont: don't shrink a page title with inline font-size
don't use a section heading as a card label
guidelines.quote: Don't skip levels or spend a level you don't need.

guidelines.title: Overlay z-order
guidelines.summary: New full-screen overlays must clear the mobile tab bar; the ladder is tokenised (misc.zindex).
do: use ladder values from tokens

guidelines.title: Spacing by role, not by vibe
guidelines.summary: Use semantic spacing roles (page/card/field/control) and the preferred scale 2/4/8/12/16/24/32/48; legacy steps remain only for compatibility.
do: snap new work to the preferred scale
